literal: Goodness of character of the noble is goodness indeed; other goodness in any goodness included is not.
translation: The true goodness of the noble is the goodness of their character. Any other kind of goodness is not counted as goodness at all.
modern: சான்றோர்களின் உண்மையான நலம் என்பது அவர்களின் நற்குணங்களே ஆகும். மற்ற நலன்கள் எந்த வகையான நலத்திலும் சேராதவை ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true wealth or goodness of noble people. It states that the excellence of their character is their only real goodness. Any other kind of advantage, such as physical beauty or material wealth, is not considered true goodness and does not belong in the category of real virtues. The word 'உள்ளதூஉம்' uses poetic lengthening to emphasize that other traits are absolutely not included in true goodness.
